scope: Preserve-all proposal with per-path metadata census, not cleanup approval

unresolvedLiteralReferences.kind: literal reference; not proof of execution

census.distribution: Do not publish the full census automatically: local artifact names may be private.

checks.stdout: PASS audit metadata fixture: tracked/untracked paths, exact reference, explicit unresolved/unknown roles, forbidden payload reads and unchanged evidence; no deletion policy inferred.

policyDecision.existingArtifacts: Preserve all existing paths and Git history, including unknown roles and reproduction dependencies

policyDecision.retirement: Separate scoped authority and preserved-byte/mode/checkpoint/retrievability proof required; none granted

limits: Per-path roles and reproduction dependencies remain unknown unless separately inspected; no inferred deletability
Literal references are not dynamic read/import/effect proof; nonliteral paths, large or nontext consumers and manual harness dependencies are not resolved
All unknown or unresolved artifacts remain preserved; no policy acceptance, move, deletion, archive or history rewrite
No operator policy agreement or v1 acceptance inferred
SourcePins are observed bytes; census snapshot can differ after local artifact creation
No claimed secret scan, complete dynamic dependency audit or per-artifact semantic classification
